`product_quantity` is VARCHAR, so it is cast to a numeric type before averaging (the numeric average may be decimal).
`product_quantity` is averaged as-is, with implicit or text conversion (possibly integer averaging or truncation).
"Ignoring missing values" means ignoring NULL `product_quantity` only.
"Ignoring missing values" means ignoring NULL and empty-string or non-numeric `product_quantity`.
Orders whose items all have missing quantity are kept, with a NULL average and NULL difference, placed last in the sort.
Orders whose items all have missing quantity are excluded, so only orders with a non-null average appear.
"Results only if the overall average exists" means return no rows when the overall average is NULL (for example, no valid quantities in the table).
